name: notion
description: Read and write Notion pages and databases with the user's own Notion token. Load for Notion search, page reads, database queries, and page updates.

content.inline:
## Notion
All calls go through `v/ops/http/get` / `v/ops/http/post` against `https://api.notion.com/v1` with `bearerSecret: "s/NOTION_TOKEN"` and the header `Notion-Version: 2022-06-28`. The token is the user's Notion personal access token (Settings → Developer Mode; uses their own permissions) or an internal connection token (pages must be shared with the connection). Never place the token in `headers`; only the secret reference.

Common calls (POST unless noted):
- Search: `POST /search` body `{query, filter?: {property: "object", value: "page"|"database"}}`
- Read a page: `GET /pages/{page_id}`; page body blocks: `GET /blocks/{page_id}/children?page_size=100` (paginate with `start_cursor`)
- Query a database: `POST /databases/{database_id}/query` body `{filter?, sorts?, page_size?}`
- Create a page: `POST /pages` body `{parent: {database_id} | {page_id}, properties, children?}`
- Update properties: `POST /pages/{page_id}` with `method: "PATCH"` and body `{properties}`
- Append blocks: `POST /blocks/{block_id}/children` with `method: "PATCH"` and body `{children: [...]}`

Rules:
- Check `status` before trusting `body`; Notion returns `{object: "error", code, message}` on failure. `unauthorized` means the token is missing or the page is not shared with the connection; `rate_limited` means back off (about 3 requests per second).
- Database property values are typed (`title`, `rich_text`, `select`, `date`, ...); read the schema from `GET /databases/{id}` before writing.
- Page and database ids may be pasted as URLs; the id is the 32-hex segment (dashes optional).
- Large pages: fetch blocks page by page and extract what the task needs; do not load whole workspaces into context.
